ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed as focal spots; estimated ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels is approximately 1:5.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular and irregular blobs ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter distributed globally across both lobes; larger contiguous white patch visible on the mid-lower section of the left lobe, partially obscured by high-intensity water spray.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior convergence; bounding-box depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge; characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with a pixel amplitude variation of roughly 10-30 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral margins of both lobes, tapering to sharp, jagged distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated clusters of roughly circular white rings and solid spots (barnacle attachment scars) concentrated heavily in the upper half of both lobes and along the trailing margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe, cutting through the dark primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable non-uniform jagged indentation on the distal half of the right lobe's trailing edge, indicating potential prior physical trauma or extensive environmental wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity, chaotic pixel patterns at the base of the fluke representing water turbulence/spray, occluding the insertion point of the peduncle.
